plan.title: directive upgrade leaves consumer wiring pointing at the deleted .deft/core, including CI steps that would silently skip

narratives.Description: OVPR fix plan group G-C (story id ovpr-g-customer-files), units P2-U5a + P2-U5b, issues #5961, #6167, #6256. Every setup run still appends retired `.deft/core/**` lines to customer `.gitattributes`, never removes the `.deft/core` lines old Directive wrote into `.prettierignore`, `greptile.json` and the CodeQL config, leaves three hook files without an LF rule, and the hook files fail customer Prettier. Stop writing and strip the retired lines, add hash-free LF lines, record the managed block, add the one RC-04 `.prettierignore` line when that file exists, remove #6479's framework-source skip (D-029) and commit the clean managed block in this repo once, and add the D-024 UPGRADING note.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`directive upgrade` removes the copied `.deft/core` tree and repoints the Taskfile `deft:` include, but does not look for other consumer files that still reference the old path. In the case below that included CI steps that would have **silently skipped** the Directive gates.

## Evidence

Measured on a TypeScript pnpm repo upgraded 0.119.11 → 0.127.0 (`directive upgrade --yes`); retested on 0.129.1 in a scratch copy: the tool does not touch CI or consumer docs there either.

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` had two steps conditioned on `if: hashFiles('.deft/core/Taskfile.yml') != ''` (installing the Directive CLI, and the xBRIEF validation). With the tree gone both steps skip and CI stays green without running the gates. A unit test in the repo asserted that exact string.
- About 20 references in the repo's own `AGENTS.md` header, plus README, a spec doc, a dependabot comment, `.gitattributes`, `.prettierignore`, codeql and greptile config.
- Doctor immediately fails `skill-paths-resolve` on a skill path in the consumer's own `AGENTS.md` (`.deft/core/.agents/skills/.../SKILL.md`). `Gates-surface readiness` also still warns, suggesting the old include path.
- The Taskfile include change is an evaluator-surface diff, so `verify:evaluator-surface` fails until a human writes `xbrief/evaluator-surface-disposition.json`. The upgrade could write, or at least name, that record.

## Suggested fix

After the swap, grep the repo for `.deft/core` and print every hit grouped by kind (CI conditions, docs, ignore files); rewrite the unambiguous ones; call out CI conditions that now evaluate false in the release notes and upgrade summary. Offer the evaluator-surface disclosure record as part of the plan.
narratives.UserStory: As a developer upgrading to the new Directive layout, I want Directive to stop writing and to remove its old `.deft/core` lines and to keep its hook files out of my lint and line-ending trouble, so that my upgrade PR is clean and my files only hold lines that mean something.

narratives.UnitSpec: ~/Projects/directive-ovpr-planning-202611/units/P2-U5-stop-writing-retired-deft-core-lines.md (read in full; the 'Update 2026-11-17' banner wins). groups.md G-C: P2-U5a + P2-U5b in one PR. RC-04 approved and merged (drafts/RC-04.md: one `.prettierignore` line). Decisions D-024 (docs note only, no scan) and D-029 (remove #6479's writer skip; commit the clean block once here).
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
U5a:
1. packages/core/src/init-deposit/scaffold.ts: `DESIRED_GITATTRIBUTES_LINES` = managed wiring lines only; rename the core lines to a retired list (with `LEGACY_CORE_TEXT_EOL_LF`); `gitattributesDepositComment` returns only the `# Deft managed wiring:` header. Remove #6479's framework-source skip (`isFrameworkSourceCheckoutAt` use in the writer) per D-029; keep #6479's pack-render change.
2. Strip every exact retired line and the known Directive comment lines (the strings `isDirectiveManagedGitattributes` lists) on every setup; add the header above remaining managed lines if missing; touch no other line; second run is a no-op.
3. Add hash-free LF lines `.claude/deft-hook-*.mjs`, `.codex/deft-hook-*.mjs`, `.cursor/hooks/deft-hook-*.mjs` (`text=auto eol=lf`).
4. New packages/core/src/init-deposit/retired-copy-model-lines.ts: the table of exact pre-OVPR strings and a strip helper for `.prettierignore` (the `.deft/core/` line, its alternates, and its header), `greptile.json` (the `.deft/core/**` ignorePatterns entry only), `.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml` (the `- '.deft/core/**'` item in all three quote forms and the two default comment lines). Call it from a runtime setup step in packages/runtime/src/setup.ts; keep the files; report each change in setup's `modified` list.
5. Record the managed `.gitattributes` block in the ownership record using P2-U0's API (marker: the `# Deft managed wiring:` header). Inventory entries `gitattributes-managed-wiring-lf` (retained, `setupActivator: "ensureManagedPathGitattributes"`) and `prettierignore-core-exclusion` (`na-retired-copy-model`).
6. This repo: commit the clean managed `.gitattributes` block once (from the worker's own worktree after setup with the fix; never polfer's uncommitted primary-checkout change).
U5b (RC-04, exact approved text):
7. In runtime setup, when a root `.prettierignore` already exists, add `**/deft-hook-*.mjs` under a `# Deft managed wiring:` header once; never create the file; record the line as Directive-owned so uninstall (G-E) can remove it.
8. content/UPGRADING.md: the ESLint flat-config `ignores: ["**/deft-hook-*.mjs"]` note (Directive never edits ESLint config) and, per D-024, in the old-layout conversion section: after converting run `git grep .deft/core` and check CI conditions that test for `.deft/core` files.
9. Tests per the spec (scaffold.test.ts, setup-wiring.test.ts, ownership-fix.test.ts, inventory test, the framework-source tests that cover the removed skip, `.prettierignore` append-only-when-present). No grep-only guard tests (groups.md).
10. Changelog fragment changelog.d/5961-no-retired-deft-core-lines.md.
narratives.Constraint:
- Do not commit, stage or revert polfer's uncommitted `.gitattributes` change in the primary checkout.
- Do not rewrite customer-authored files: CI workflows, README, specs, the customer's AGENTS.md header (AC10.6).
- Do not scan or list `.deft/core` references in files Directive doesn't own (D-024); docs note only.
- Do not delete `greptile.json` or the CodeQL config file.
- Do not add a framework-source or 'is this the Directive repo' check to the writer; remove the existing one (D-029).
- Do not create `.prettierignore` or ESLint config in a project that lacks them; never edit ESLint config (AC7.7).
- Use the RC-04 approved text exactly for the `.prettierignore` line; no other new ignore or attribute lines.
- Do not touch `.github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml` (G-B) or the hook outer source, its hash or old-shim cleanup.
- Scott's dispatcher, scope gate and `verify:scope-provenance` stay untouched.
- OVPR change gate: read ~/Projects/directive-ovpr-planning-202611/OVPR-CHANGE-GATE.md. Do not edit docs/installer-refactor-ovpr/ and do not ship behaviour that departs from the written OVPR requirements or architecture; stop that part and hand back a change proposal.
- Changelog: add the changelog.d fragment named in file_scope; never edit CHANGELOG.md.
narratives.Dependencies: Depends on: P2-U0 ownership record API (#6658 merged; part 2 #6662 / github.issue.6458882573 active) for step 5; if the needed form is missing, ship the rest and report. Blocks: G-E (uninstall reuses the retired-lines table and removes the recorded lines), P4-U1 (Scott's commit gate reads the record). Tell Scott before dispatch (D-029).
narratives.PlanningOrder: design-critique: not warranted, because the OVPR fix plan and its unit specs already decide the design (polfer decisions D-001, D-008, D-037)
narratives.Traces: Closes #5961 and #6256. Partly addresses #6167 (items 1 and 2; items 3 and 4 belong elsewhere). Refs #6337, #6479, #2534.

items.title: On a fresh `directive install`, no file Directive writes contains `.deft/core`.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an empty repo, when `runSetup({ operation: "install" })` runs, then no file it writes or modifies contains the text `.deft/core`.

items.title: On upgrade, repair and automatic setup, the exact retired lines are removed from `.gitattributes`, `.prettierignore`, `greptile.json` and `.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml`; every other line and key is byte-identical and the files are kept.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a repo with the old 19-line `.gitattributes` block, an old `.prettierignore`, `greptile.json` and CodeQL config, when setup runs with `operation` upgrade, repair or automatic setup, then exactly the retired lines are removed, all other lines and keys are byte-identical, and all four files still exist.

items.title: The removals are listed as modified files in the install, upgrade and repair report.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a repo with retired lines, when `directive upgrade` or `directive install --repair` runs, then each file whose retired lines were removed is listed under the files to review and commit.

items.title: Running setup twice in a row changes nothing the second time.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a repo where setup has just run, when setup runs again, then no file is modified.

items.title: `.gitattributes` has an LF rule matching each of the four hook files for any sha8.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a repo after setup, when `git check-attr eol --` runs on `.claude/deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs`, `.codex/deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs`, `.cursor/hooks/deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs` and `.grok/hooks/deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs` for an arbitrary sha8, then each reports `eol: lf`.

items.title: The managed `.gitattributes` block is in the ownership record in the P2-U0 form.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a repo after setup, when `.deft/GENERATION.json` is read through the P2-U0 ownership API, then it lists the managed `.gitattributes` block identified by the `# Deft managed wiring:` header.

items.title: The inventory lists the managed LF block and the retired `.prettierignore` line.

narrative.Acceptance: Given packages/runtime/src/installer-output-inventory.ts, when it is read, then it has `gitattributes-managed-wiring-lf` (retained, activator `ensureManagedPathGitattributes`) and `prettierignore-core-exclusion` (`na-retired-copy-model`).

items.title: In this repo, with the framework-source skip removed and the clean block committed once, session start, verify tasks and swarm worktree prep in a linked worktree leave `.gitattributes` unchanged.

narrative.Acceptance: Given this repo with the clean managed block committed and no framework-source skip in the writer, when `session:start`, `task verify:*` or `swarm-worktrees prep` runs in a linked worktree, then `git status` shows no change to `.gitattributes`.

items.title: An existing `.prettierignore` gets `**/deft-hook-*.mjs` once under the managed header (RC-04); a project without one gets no new file; UPGRADING names the Prettier and ESLint entries and the D-024 `git grep .deft/core` note.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a project with a root `.prettierignore`, when setup runs twice, then the file has exactly one `**/deft-hook-*.mjs` line under `# Deft managed wiring:`; given a project without one, when setup runs, then no `.prettierignore` is created; and content/UPGRADING.md names the Prettier line, the ESLint `ignores` entry and the post-conversion `git grep .deft/core` / CI-condition check.
